**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (High-tier review of the E2a layer, 7c1bc3ba..80a79a15, on top of the already-reviewed #782.)

### What looks good
- The permutation is correct for every turn. `Axes::key` maps old index to new as `new[a] = old[src[a]]`, negated with `!`. `Axes::brick` uses the same `src`/`neg` for the slot. I checked the identity `8*(!b) + (7 - s) == !(8b + s)`, so a mirrored brick lands exactly on the mirrored cells. Brick lattices are origin-locked and unbounded, so odd-sized stock has no edge case. `!` is total on `i32`, and the slot arithmetic is `saturating_sub` on values in 0..8.
- Prime Directive holds. `field_turn.rs` has no `unwrap`, `expect`, `panic!` or unchecked index outside `#[cfg(test)]`. Writes go through `get_mut`.
- `bounded_cuts` can't be skipped. `field_turn.rs:~134` sets it to `self.bounded_cuts || (flips && !self.cuts.is_empty())`. It is sticky, because `field_cut.rs:205` only ORs it in and nothing clears it. `field_floor.rs:100` is its only consumer, and it returns `CutFromBelow` before any march. The flipped bake keeps `cuts`, so `cut_near` still sees the claims.
- `cut_ups` and `cut_downs` swap on a flip only. `cut_layer_bytes` counts the new layer. Dirty marking covers cuts, ups and downs, so the ledger stays a superset of what moved.
- The `field.rs` split moves code unchanged. `validate_shell` and `edge_key` are identical to the old text, and the only diff in the moved tests is the import line and `pub(crate) mod tests`. `#[test]` count is preserved: 3 moved from `field.rs` to `field_shell.rs`, plus 3 new in `field_turn`. `field.rs` is 340 lines and `field_turn.rs` is 246.
- Decision file `docs/decisions/779-field-turn-bake.md` is present. The body carries `Changelog: none`, `Effort: high (no escalation)` and `Fixes #779`. No process files, dependencies, `build.rs`, snapshots or goldens are touched.

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main v0.17.0, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` quick-gate plan, lib + 27 suites incl. `carry_engine_agreement` (6), `field_carry` (9), `field_body`, `field_floor`, `stock_carry`, `stock_backend_parity`, `stock_sdf_cut`, `stock_sim` | all green, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| motion `posed_subtract` and app `stock_export`/`verify` | not rerun: the diff is sim-only, and the author's quick and Linux batch gates are green |

Mutation spot-check, both reverted afterwards:
- Changing the slot mirror from `n-1` to `n-2` fails `field_carry::a_baked_turn_reads_bit_for_bit_what_the_view_reads`, `carry_engine_agreement::a_baked_turn_reads_what_the_view_reads_through_every_turn` and the two `field_turn` unit tests.
- Dropping the flip clause from `bounded_cuts` fails `a_flip_moves_every_up_record_down_and_back`.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Nothing outside `field_turn`'s own test reads `bounded_cuts` after a flip. The refusal at `field_floor.rs:100` is not pinned by a flipped-bake test, which the PR already lists under "Not exercised". Please add that pin when E2b lands.
- The body says "fork synced at v0.16.0", but v0.17.0 is out. The trial merge with it is clean.
- The PR is stacked on #782, so the diff shown here includes E1 until it merges.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
